tool_schemas.name: list_boards
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Monday boards for the given account, optionally filtered by workspace and status, returning a sorted, cursor-paginated result set (use limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any parameter is malformed/out of range (including id patterns) or if cursor/sort/order are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced account/workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if account_id (or workspace_id when provided) does not exist in cache or is not visible to the caller.

account_id.description: Monday account cache id to scope the board listing.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace cache id to filter boards.

limit.description: Maximum number of boards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_board
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached board by board_id and returns its stored details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if board_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to view the board. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible in the scoped account.

tool_schemas.name: get_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached items for a board, optionally filtered by status, group_id, and created_by, returning a sorted, cursor-paginated result set (use limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed/out of range or if cursor/sort/order are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced board. Raises NOT_FOUND if board_id does not exist in cache or is not visible to the caller.

board_id.description: Board cache id to list items for.

group_id.description: Filter items by Monday group id.

created_by.description: Filter items by creator identifier as stored in cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached workspaces for the given account, optionally filtered by status, returning a sorted, cursor-paginated result set (use limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed/out of range (including id patterns) or if cursor/sort/order are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced account. Raises NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist in cache or is not visible to the caller.

account_id.description: Monday account cache id to scope the workspace listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached workspace by workspace_id and returns its stored details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to view the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible in the scoped account.

tool_schemas.name: get_item
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached item by item_id and returns its stored details, including cached status and any stored column_values. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if item_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to view the item or its parent board. Raises NOT_FOUND if the item_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: get_boards
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached boards for a workspace, optionally filtered by status, returning a sorted, cursor-paginated result set (use limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are malformed/out of range or if cursor/sort/order are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if workspace_id does not exist in cache or is not visible to the caller.

workspace_id.description: Workspace cache id to list boards for.

limit.description: Maximum number of boards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create_item
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new cached item in the specified cached board with the provided name and optional group_id and column_values, returning the created item record; if idempotency_key is provided, repeated requests with the same key return the original created item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including id patterns and empty name) or if column_values is not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create items on the referenced board. Raises NOT_FOUND if board_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the idempotency_key is already bound to a different create request payload for the same scope.

board_id.description: Board cache id to create the item in.

group_id.description: Optional Monday group id to create the item under.

column_values.description: Optional Monday column values payload stored on the cached item.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate creates on retries.

tool_schemas.name: delete_item
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a cached item by item_id and returns the updated item record (or a deletion confirmation) reflecting its deleted status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if item_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot delete items on the item’s parent board. Raises NOT_FOUND if item_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the item is already deleted or is in a non-deletable workflow state (e.g., pending_create).

item_id.description: Internal cached item id to delete (items.id).

tool_schemas.name: create_item_with_demo
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new cached item on the specified cached board, optionally generating demo column values based on demo_mode (none, all_columns, or selected_columns) and merging them with any explicit column_values, returning the created item; if idempotency_key is provided, repeated requests with the same key return the original created item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, name is missing/empty, demo_mode is invalid, demo_column_ids is required/invalid for selected_columns, or column_values is not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create items for the given account/board. Raises NOT_FOUND if account_id or board_id does not exist in cache or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the idempotency_key is already bound to a different create request payload for the same scope.

account_id.description: Monday account cache id that owns the board (monday_accounts.id).

board_id.description: Internal cached board id to create the item on (boards.id).

name.description: Item name to create on the board.

group_id.description: Target Monday group id to create the item in (items.group_id).

demo_mode.description: Whether to generate demo column values for none, all, or selected columns.

demo_column_ids.description: Column ids to generate demo data for when demo_mode is selected_columns.

column_values.description: Explicit column values to set on create (merged with any demo values).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate creates on retries.

tool_schemas.name: create_multiple_items
tool_schemas.description: Creates a bulk item creation job for the given cached board, immediately creates and returns a first “example” item, and records the remaining count to be created later; item names are generated from item_name_prefix and optional demo column values are generated per demo_mode (and demo_column_ids when selected_columns), merged with template_column_values. Returns the bulk job (including its id, requested_total, created counts, and the example item) and replays the same job on retries when idempotency_key matches. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid, requested_total < 1, demo_mode is selected_columns without demo_column_ids, or demo_column_ids contains duplicates/unknown ids; UNAUTHORIZED when the account/board is not accessible for the caller; NOT_FOUND when account_id or board_id does not exist in cache (or board is not owned by account_id); CONFLICT when an idempotency_key is reused with different parameters or the job cannot be initialized; QUOTA_EXCEEDED when creation limits are reached.

account_id.description: Monday account cache id that owns the board (monday_accounts.id).

board_id.description: Internal cached board id to create items on (boards.id).

requested_total.description: Total number of items to create in this bulk job.

item_name_prefix.description: Prefix for generated item names (e.g. "Demo Item").

group_id.description: Target Monday group id for created items (items.group_id).

demo_mode.description: Whether to generate demo column values for none, all, or selected columns.

demo_column_ids.description: Column ids to generate demo data for when demo_mode is selected_columns.

template_column_values.description: Base column values applied to every created item (bulk_item_jobs.template_column_values).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for creating/returning the same bulk job on retries.

tool_schemas.name: create_remaining_items
tool_schemas.description: Continues a previously started bulk item job by creating all remaining items that were deferred after the example item, and returns the updated job with final created counts; repeated calls with the same idempotency_key return the prior result without creating duplicates. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when bulk_item_job_id is malformed or idempotency_key is invalid; UNAUTHORIZED when the job is not accessible for the caller; NOT_FOUND when bulk_item_job_id does not exist; CONFLICT when the job is already complete, is not in a state that allows continuation (e.g., not initialized/failed), or the idempotency_key was previously used for a different continuation request; QUOTA_EXCEEDED when creation limits are reached.

bulk_item_job_id.description: Bulk item job id to continue (bulk_item_jobs.id).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for the 'create remaining' run to prevent duplicate execution.

tool_schemas.name: update_bulk_item_job
tool_schemas.description: Updates a bulk item job with allowed state transitions and editable draft fields. Supports resetting a failed job back to 'draft' for retry, and cancelling a draft/example_created/running job. Rejects invalid lifecycle transitions. Rejects with FORBIDDEN if monday_accounts.status != 'active' for any state transition that would allow creation to proceed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed input and UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_FOUND if the job is not accessible.

bulk_item_job_id.description: Bulk item job cache id to update.

status.description: New job status; must be a valid transition for the current status.

requested_total.description: When status is 'draft', optionally update the requested total items (including the example item).

item_name_prefix.description: When status is 'draft', optionally update the item name prefix.

group_id.description: When status is 'draft', optionally update the target Monday group id.

demo_mode.description: When status is 'draft', optionally enable/disable demo mode.

demo_column_ids.description: When status is 'draft' and demo_mode=true, optionally update the demo-eligible column ids.

template_column_values.description: When status is 'draft', optionally update the template column values applied to each created item.
